versions.name: Camp Strake

features.note: A 28-acre lake.
An aquatics center with a swimming pool and pool house.
Lake fishing for bass, sunfish, and bluegill; hooks must be barbless.
Texas hunter safety and bowhunter safety courses.
A combined climbing and rappelling tower.
High- and low-ropes courses, with suspended platforms and mid-air obstacles.
Two 850-foot zip lines over the lake.
A marked mountain bike trail served by a bike barn; bikes and helmets provided.
Offered within the older-Scout high-adventure track.
A STEM center.
Camp provides welding jackets, gloves, and helmets.
A Frisbee golf course.
Air-conditioned dining hall seating 450.
In the camp headquarters building.
A covered pavilion with picnic tables at every campsite, plus the Grand Pavilion.
Two-person wall tents on wooden pallets.
Adirondacks in select campsites sleep eight.
Two electrical outlets at each campsite pavilion.
Built to meet both ADA and Scouting America requirements.
Voyager, a patrol-based track for first-year Scouts.
Mission Lone Star, a full-week older-Scout track combining zip line, COPE, climbing, shooting sports, aquatics, ATV, and a NASA visit.
Primitive camping on the Lone Star Trail.
Super Troop, registered by the parent rather than by a unit.

versions.summary: Sam Houston Area Council's Scouts BSA resident summer camp near Coldspring, Texas.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
